senses.definition: a place where planes arrive and leave

sentences.en: We arrived at the airport two hours early.
sentences.ru: Мы приехали в аэропорт за два часа.

sentences.en: The airport is far from the city centre.
She met her sister at the airport.
Our flight leaves from the new airport.
sentences.ru: Наш рейс вылетает из нового аэропорта.

sentences.en: Is there a bus from the airport to the hotel?
sentences.ru: От аэропорта до отеля ходит автобус?

senses.definition: a small piece of paper that lets you travel or enter

sentences.en: I bought two tickets for the evening train.
sentences.ru: Я купил два билета на вечерний поезд.

sentences.en: The ticket costs ten pounds.
Keep your ticket in your pocket.
We could not find our tickets.
sentences.ru: Мы не смогли найти наши билеты.

sentences.en: Can I pay for the ticket by card?

senses.definition: the bags you take when you travel

sentences.en: My luggage is very heavy.
Please leave your luggage at the hotel.
They lost our luggage at the airport.
sentences.ru: Они потеряли наш багаж в аэропорту.

sentences.en: How much luggage can I take on the plane?
sentences.ru: Сколько багажа я могу взять в самолёт?

sentences.en: Her luggage was ready by the door.
sentences.ru: Её багаж стоял готовый у двери.

senses.definition: travel from one place to another

sentences.en: The journey to the mountains took six hours.
sentences.ru: Поездка в горы заняла шесть часов.

sentences.en: How was your journey?
We stopped for coffee during the journey.
sentences.ru: Мы остановились на кофе во время поездки.

sentences.en: It is a long journey by train.
I slept for most of the journey.

senses.definition: a place where you pay to sleep and eat

sentences.en: We stayed at a small hotel near the sea.
sentences.ru: Мы жили в маленьком отеле у моря.

sentences.en: The hotel has a restaurant on the ground floor.
sentences.ru: В отеле есть ресторан на первом этаже.

sentences.en: Our room was on the third floor of the hotel.
sentences.ru: Наша комната была на третьем этаже отеля.

sentences.en: He works at a hotel in the city centre.
sentences.ru: Он работает в отеле в центре города.

sentences.en: The hotel was full, so we found another one.
sentences.ru: Отель был полон, поэтому мы нашли другой.

senses.definition: the state of the air: sun, rain, wind, cold

sentences.en: The weather is lovely today.
What was the weather like on your holiday?
sentences.ru: Какая погода была в твой отпуск?

sentences.en: We stayed at home because of the bad weather.
sentences.ru: Мы остались дома из-за плохой погоды.

sentences.en: The weather changes quickly in spring.
I check the weather before I go out.

senses.definition: water that falls from the sky

sentences.en: It is going to rain this afternoon.
The rain stopped before we left.
sentences.ru: Дождь закончился до того, как мы вышли.

sentences.en: I forgot my umbrella in the rain.
We walked home in the cold rain.
sentences.ru: Мы шли домой под холодным дождём.

sentences.en: There was a lot of rain last night.

senses.definition: with a lot of light from the sun

sentences.en: It was a sunny morning in May.
sentences.ru: Это было солнечное утро в мае.

sentences.en: The room is bright and sunny.
We had a sunny weekend by the lake.
sentences.ru: У нас были солнечные выходные у озера.

sentences.en: Tomorrow will be warm and sunny.
I like sunny days more than rainy ones.
sentences.ru: Я люблю солнечные дни больше дождливых.

senses.definition: having a low temperature

sentences.en: It is very cold outside today.
The water in the lake was cold.
Put on a warm coat, it is cold.
I caught a cold last week.
My hands are cold after the walk.
sentences.ru: У меня замёрзли руки после прогулки.

senses.definition: pleasantly hot, not cold

sentences.en: The evening was warm and quiet.
This jacket is too warm for summer.
sentences.ru: Эта куртка слишком тёплая для лета.

sentences.en: We sat by the fire to keep warm.
sentences.ru: Мы сидели у огня, чтобы согреться.

sentences.en: The water is warm enough for swimming.
She gave me a warm smile.

senses.definition: a person who helps people who are ill

sentences.en: My mother works as a doctor.
You should see a doctor about that cough.
sentences.ru: Тебе стоит показаться врачу из-за этого кашля.

sentences.en: The doctor asked me to open my mouth.
We called the doctor at night.
The doctor said I need to rest.
sentences.ru: Врач сказал, что мне нужно отдыхать.

senses.definition: something you take when you are ill

sentences.en: Take this medicine twice a day.
sentences.ru: Принимай это лекарство два раза в день.

sentences.en: The medicine tastes quite bitter.
I bought some medicine for my headache.
sentences.ru: Я купил лекарство от головной боли.

sentences.en: Keep the medicine away from children.
This medicine helped me sleep.

senses.definition: good for your body; not ill

sentences.en: Fruit and vegetables are healthy.
She tries to eat healthy food.
Walking every day keeps you healthy.
My brother is tall and healthy.
A healthy breakfast gives you energy.

senses.definition: needing rest or sleep

sentences.en: I was tired after the long journey.
The children are tired and want to sleep.
You look tired today.
She feels tired in the evening.
We were too tired to cook dinner.
sentences.ru: Мы слишком устали, чтобы готовить ужин.

senses.definition: wanting to eat

sentences.en: I am hungry, let's have lunch.
The baby gets hungry every three hours.
sentences.ru: Малыш хочет есть каждые три часа.

sentences.en: Were you hungry after the walk?
She was too hungry to wait.
sentences.ru: Она была слишком голодна, чтобы ждать.

sentences.en: We bought sandwiches because we were hungry.
sentences.ru: Мы купили бутерброды, потому что проголодались.

senses.definition: the activity of buying things in shops

sentences.en: We went shopping for new clothes.
Shopping in this street is expensive.
She does her shopping on Saturdays.
I have two bags of shopping.
sentences.ru: У меня две сумки с покупками.

sentences.en: Online shopping is quick and easy.

senses.definition: coins and paper notes used to buy things

sentences.en: I do not have enough money for a new phone.
sentences.ru: У меня недостаточно денег на новый телефон.

sentences.en: He saves money every month.
How much money did you spend?
She paid the money into the bank.
We need money for the trip.

senses.definition: how much you must pay for something

sentences.en: The price of the ticket is fair.
Prices in this shop are low.
What is the price of this bag?
The price went up last week.
I asked about the price of the room.

senses.definition: costing little money

sentences.en: This hotel is cheap but clean.
We found a cheap flight to Rome.
sentences.ru: Мы нашли дешёвый билет в Рим.

sentences.en: The tickets are cheaper on weekdays.
It is not cheap, but it is very good.
She bought a cheap pair of shoes.

senses.definition: costing a lot of money

sentences.en: That restaurant is too expensive for us.
sentences.ru: Тот ресторан слишком дорогой для нас.

sentences.en: The hotel was more expensive than we thought.
sentences.ru: Отель оказался дороже, чем мы думали.

sentences.en: He drives an expensive car.
Everything in this city is expensive.
I like the bag, but it is expensive.
sentences.ru: Мне нравится сумка, но она дорогая.

senses.definition: things you wear, like shirts and trousers

sentences.en: I need to wash my clothes.
She wears warm clothes in winter.
These clothes are too small for me.
We packed our clothes in one bag.
sentences.ru: Мы сложили одежду в одну сумку.

sentences.en: He buys clothes twice a year.
sentences.ru: Он покупает одежду два раза в год.

senses.definition: to have clothes on your body

sentences.en: I wear a coat when it is cold.
She was wearing a blue dress.
Do you have to wear a uniform at work?
sentences.ru: Тебе нужно носить форму на работе?

sentences.en: He never wears a hat.
What are you going to wear to the party?

senses.definition: to get something by paying money

sentences.en: I want to buy a present for my sister.
We bought bread and milk this morning.
sentences.ru: Утром мы купили хлеб и молоко.

sentences.en: Where did you buy those shoes?
She is going to buy a new laptop.
You can buy tickets at the door.

senses.definition: the work you do to earn money

sentences.en: He found a new job in the city.
sentences.ru: Он нашёл новую работу в городе.

sentences.en: My job starts at nine o'clock.
She likes her job very much.
It is not easy to get a good job.
They offered him a job in London.
sentences.ru: Они предложили ему работу в Лондоне.

senses.definition: a time when people come together to talk

sentences.en: The meeting starts at ten.
We had a long meeting yesterday.
sentences.ru: Вчера у нас было долгое совещание.

sentences.en: She is in a meeting right now.
I will send you the notes after the meeting.
sentences.ru: Я пришлю тебе заметки после встречи.

sentences.en: Our meeting was moved to Friday.
